verses: Hanpety huye dorney walay ghoron ki qasam
Phir taap maar ker aag jharnay walon ki qasam
Phir subha kay waqt dhaawa bolney walon ki qasam
Pus uss waqt gird o ghubaar uratay hain
Phir ussi kay sath fojon kay darmiyan ghuss jatay hain
Yaqeenan insan apney rab ka bara nashukra hai
Aur yaqeenan woh khud bhi uss per gawah hai
Yeh maal ki mehnat mein bhi bara sakht hai
Kiya ussay woh waqt maloom nahi jab qabron mein jo (kuch) hai nikal liya jaye ga
Aur seenon ki posheedah baaten zahir ker di jayen gi
Be-shak unn ka rab uss din unn kay haal say poora ba-khabar hoga
